title: Small bias generator density
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a nonzero natural number $\ell$, define a probability density on the binary cube of dimension $n$ by taking the uniform pushforward under the small bias generator of a uniformly chosen pair of elements of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
